source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: What does alignment work aim to improve?

options.text: The match between system responses and the behavior people intend
options.feedback: Alignment aims to make behavior fit intended goals and constraints reliably. Training can encourage that fit without guaranteeing it in every context.

options.text: The enforcement of limits on which external actions tools can execute
options.feedback: This describes harness permissions and access controls. They constrain execution, whereas alignment addresses the behavior the model chooses.

options.text: The accuracy of a prediction about the next token in existing text
options.feedback: This describes the foundational text-model prediction objective. Strong prediction alone does not establish that responses fit the behavior people intend.

options.text: The confirmation that a completed artifact contains the requested work
options.feedback: This describes verification of a result. Alignment instead concerns improving the system behavior that produces responses and proposes actions.
